name: Swarm Slope
mix: Yellow belt and up. Bouncy Boppers + swarmers: watch for the staff going up, then step aside or Counter. L11 swap: every Swarmers -> Doughlings.
legend: # = wall, . = floor, P = player start, D = door slot (in the outer wall), C = chest, S = rest shrine
waves_note: Enemies arrive in waves: the next wave comes when 1 enemy (or none) is left.
artProps: Layout copied from bopper-yard. Theme and props from the giants-steps draft room "swarm-slope". A loose gravel hillside; the diagonal stone blocks are old steps that slid into a V.
signs: Small stones tumble. Big hearts hold.
